text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since New Year's Day, I had spent my 
days quietly keeping watch over Win 
Variation.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, good morning! I look forward to 
working with you today too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her expression and words were refreshing 
and cheerful, showing no sign that 
anything was troubling her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Thump!!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah... S-Sorry! I was just a little 
short...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There were more and more times when she 
couldn't hold on to the end. ...'I want to 
think for myself and work through it.' I 
want to respect her feelings on that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"While thinking that, as a Trainer, I 
couldn't help but feel frustrated."
choice_data_list:
(Like we did for New Year's, is there 
something I can do...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Thinking that—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Happy?

text_block_list.name: Cheval & Viv
text_block_list.text: Valenti~ne♡ Va... Valentine's Day?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Heh...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Wh-What is this!? Trainer!?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh...? We were told that we would be 
hosting a chocolate party, though...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: A ch-chocolate party?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And so, wondering what might be fun to 
do, she decided to host a chocolate party.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Verxina, with whom she shared a sense 
of camaraderie, she could surely enjoy 
herself without reservation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Besides, you might even be able to 
consult them about things you wouldn't 
feel comfortable sharing with me."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To her and her younger sister— the 
introverted, kind-hearted Cheval Grand, 
who is also Win Variation's roommate—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An invitation was also sent to her younger 
sister, the cheerful and trendy Umamusume, 
Vivlos.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Word is they've ordered chocolates from 
all over the world for a comparative 
tasting."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
So, that's why there's this mountain of 
chocolate, huh...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry for all of us barging in when 
you're already going through such a tough 
time...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Still, um... I'm really, really looking 
forward to it...!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
From here it's Belgium, Switzerland, 
Paris, and Vienna—oh, this one! It won 
first place in last year's international 
contest~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, let's hurry up and get started~!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
U-Understood! Um, plates, plates... Did we 
really have five plates?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, amidst a somewhat chaotic 
atmosphere, the party began――

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Nn... Ah, praline's kinda like caramel, 
huh.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I hear this is a royal warrant holder. I 
see, it's so fragrant and rich...!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
That looks like it'd go well with coffee. 
Maybe I'll brew some.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Macaron, macaron, macarooon~♪ Mmm, it's so 
hard to choose when there's only one of 
each~! Raspberry, or vanilla looks good 
too...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Looks delicious. I wonder which one I 
should pick...

text_block_list.name: Shion & Cheval
text_block_list.text: The lemon looks so delicio—

text_block_list.name: Shion & Cheval
text_block_list.text: Ah! Please, go right ahead!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Ah... Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry...! Oh no, what should I do? Um, 
well then—

text_block_list.name: Shion & Cheval
text_block_list.text: Would you like to share halves?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...! Heh, hehehe, oh, Cheval...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: S-Same goes for you, Shion-san...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
They say only one piece is super sour! 
Let's all eat one together on three! 
Ready, go!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Alright, alright, ready, go!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ……? Or maybe not……?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Mmh!? Mmm-mmgh!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, ahaha! Shion-san, you hit the 
bullseye, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa, that looks sour! How is it? How is 
it, how is it~?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Sour, it's way too sour! Whoa! Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The mountain of chocolate had completely 
vanished before anyone even realized it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, I didn't see her asking for 
any advice, but caught up in the lively 
energy of the three sisters, it seemed she 
had a wonderful time as well—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Well then... until next time on the track. 
Have a good night.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Good night!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. It got quiet all of a sudden. 
Feels like the calm after the storm, 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"That was fun. Thank you so much for 
putting this together."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yes... I got so absorbed in it, I 
almost forgot about the race.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I think I'll sleep well tonight.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, that's right! This is for you, 
Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for giving you more chocolate 
when you already have so much... ...Thank 
you, as always.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"From tomorrow on as well, I look forward 
to working with you, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Listening to the light footsteps fade into 
the distance, I opened the present and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Round, red chocolates carrying a faint 
scent of apple were lined up like precious 
gems.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Phew...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Umm... Well then, I should probably be 
heading out too.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"From tomorrow on as well, I look forward 
to working with you."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, after Win Variation headed home, 
I was tidying up my desk when— I noticed 
an unfamiliar present sitting there."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I open the enclosed card. It was from Win 
Variation.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Did I surprise ya? I left it here in 
secret."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Here's a return gift for the chocolate 
party! It's a surprise!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much for working hard on so 
many things."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"I guess I'm telling you the exact same 
thing as back during summer camp. But my 
feelings of gratitude haven't changed at 
all since then."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "‘I'm always sorry. Win Variation.’"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inside the present was a massive apple 
pie—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inside was an apple pie that showed an 
even greater level of skill than the one 
received over the summer.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Phew...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(That party was so much fun. I feel 
like... it's been a long time since I 
laughed that much.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Even so, why would Trainer suddenly do 
something like this...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Could it be... it was showing on my face 
again?)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Or maybe... she's still worried about 
what I said on New Year's...?)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...Right. It's Trainer-san, after all. It 
must be. That's why they called out to me 
and prepared all that chocolate.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (...I'm truly blessed.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...I need to stay positive. If I do, I 
know I won't lose my nerve.)
